localChanges: Most of this is not guessable from the outside and each item cost real time to diagnose, so it goes where the next person will look rather than in a commit message they will never read.

`04-package-workflow.md` gains "What actually goes wrong": the registry lying twice (propagation lag, and staged-versus-published conflicts reading alike), the four pnpm 10→11 settings of which `minimumReleaseAge` fails silently and quietly resolves *past* a fresh publish, `tsc --build` skipping so a stale success looks real, `publishConfig.access` being required for a new scoped package and therefore a reliable signal for which packages belong on npm at all, 2FA stopping a wave dead and why that forces an idempotent release, `simple-ai-client` being uninstallable and why symlinking around it destroyed a neighbouring tree, tests that were never runnable, tests that never asserted, and untracked files that are not ours to commit.

`tools/README.md` gains the three rules the tools now encode: a tool that preserves a file must keep it current; a codemod a rollout re-runs must recognise its own output; a check that cannot run is not a check that passed.

`tests/engine/fixtures/NOTES.md` records what the suite has actually caught, and the two rules that came out of it — an instrument must not change the thing it measures, and a run that produces nothing is a failure not a pass.
`state-rewrite/09-phase-4-backend-deltas.md` gets the one wire-format change the `#private` migration made, measured, because a delta protocol will see it.
